evidence_checked: field-by-field diff against the blind-review control (only the two first_end dates differ)
hash and quoted-span checks from the blind review (all matched)
reasoning: The genuine claim matches the planted control field for field except that the first_end dates of sections 10(b) and 11(h) are 1987-01-23, so every hash and quoted-span check from the blind review still holds. Identity: EO 12580 of January 23, 1987, 52 FR 2923, Superfund Implementation. The 79 clause spans together cover the whole order text from the authority paragraph to the end of section 11(h); the only text between spans is a page header and the FR Doc footer. Sections 10(b) (amendment of EO 12088) and 11(h) (revocation of EO 12316) are self-executing commands. The order states no later effective date, so recording them as terminated by performance on 1987-01-23, with EO 12580 as actor, is correct and consistent with the judgment_reason. The OFR note (Amended by EO 12777, 13016, 13286, 13308; no revocation) is fully addressed. EO 12777 section 1(a) restates section 1. I compared the restated text with the original: it keeps every original paragraph, (a)(1)-(4), (b)(1)-(2), (c)(1)-(5), (d) and (e), so the section 1 clauses continue as amended. The claim describes that amendment in each section 1 clause and does not attach it as a later event, giving the page-check status of the held printing as the reason; this is consistent with the rationale, which does not claim it is attached. The attached events check out: EO 13286 section 43 inserts Homeland Security and strikes FEMA in section 1(a)(2), effective March 1, 2003 under section 92. EO 13308 section 1 adds 105(h) to section 1(b)(1), section 2 adds 5(f) and 5(g), and section 3 adds sections 12 to 14. EO 13016 adds 4(c)(3) and 4(d)(3). Current predicate: EPA final rule FR Doc. 2026-04904 (91 FR, March 13, 2026, 40 CFR part 300) applies EO 12580 and cites it as authority. The cruden number search finds no revoking or superseding order. No savings issue arises. Upheld.
